An amendment that names no present row fails the gate, unless the row was retired and its item is closed. An owner transfer is a later record for the same row naming the owner it takes over from (transfer_from), with the same item and dev sha; the earlier record stays as the measured owner and the last record is the row's current owner (coordinator 2026-10-09).
